### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

operational and R&D excellence.”

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

Who We Serve?

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly
understand important technology trends, identify the competitive threats, uncover partnership
opportunities, and decide the direction of innovation.

### New Product Innovation Leader

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,
validate new ideas, and find the gaps in the market!

### Technology Research Analysts

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.
Why Discovery?
[Technology Intelligence Data Foundation]

### Technology Intelligence Data Foundation

Discovery brings company, patent, literature, investment, M&A, news, and research funding together
in one platform. Powered by AI and machine learning, the platform is continually updated with the
latest global data points.These connected insights provide a meaningful foundation for you to
analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.
[Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators]

### Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators

With our technology classification and ranking system, we help you quickly understand a company's
R&D strategy through patent portfolio and technology roadmap visualizations. This data empowers you
to measure a company’s innovation capability, technical influence, innovation originality, scale,
and stability.
[AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar]

### AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar

With our 24/7, AI-powered data processing pipeline, we automate the competitor monitoring process so
you don’t miss important insights that could impact your innovation strategy.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

### –Proudly Made In The USA–

# We Measure Success

In disciplines where precision measurements can mean the difference between success or failure,
HOGGAN Scientific sets the standard. Our products are found in leading universities, hospitals,
physical, occupational, sports medicine and sports teams facilities. We are essential to the
automobile, aerospace, food, packaging industries and are counted on in pharmaceutical trials and
scientific research around the globe. HOGGAN Scientific’s innovation, design, and manufacturing
prowess is a trusted ally in a world where precision matters.

[Sign up for Announcements and Information][37]

## New Product Introduction

The new **microFET2 MT Stabilizer Kit** improves accuracy, objectivity and reliability for
conducting muscle force measurements with either **microFET2** or **ergoFET**.  The MT stabilizer
kit transforms microFET2 handheld dynamometer or ergoFET gauge from a “semi-fixed” to more “fixed”
testing method by improving stabilization and minimizing tester influence.

[View Product Details][38]
* [[MicroFET2 Stabilizer Kit for Muscle testing]][39]
* [[Hands adjusting ankle strap over sneakers]][40]
* [[Ankle monitor strapped to seated person's legs]][41]

## Hoggan Scientific Extends Free Warranty Coverage from One Year to Three Years to Thank Customers

To show Hoggan Scientific’s ongoing commitment to customer satisfaction and product excellence, they
are announcing a major enhancement to its warranty policy. Effective immediately, all new devices
purchased after September 4, 2025 will be covered by a three-year warranty, up from the previous
one-year coverage period, at no cost to customers. This milestone reflects not only Hoggan
Scientifc’s dedication to standing behind these products but also their pride in maintaining
rigorous quality standards, as demonstrated by their ISO and MDR certifications.

## Hoggan Scientific’s continuous commitment to the highest quality standards have resulted in
## accomplishment of IS0 13485:2016 for the scope of the design, development, and manufacture of
## non-sterile dynamometer and inclinometer measuring devices and related accessories of our
## MicroFET product line.

### –Proudly Made In The USA–

# We Measure Success

In disciplines where precision measurements can mean the difference between success or failure,
HOGGAN Scientific sets the standard. Our products are found in leading universities, hospitals,
physical, occupational, sports medicine and sports teams facilities. We are essential to the
automobile, aerospace, food, packaging industries and are counted on in pharmaceutical trials and
scientific research around the globe. HOGGAN Scientific’s innovation, design, and manufacturing
prowess is a trusted ally in a world where precision matters.

[Sign up for Announcements and Information][37]

## New Product Introduction

The new **microFET2 MT Stabilizer Kit** improves accuracy, objectivity and reliability for
conducting muscle force measurements with either **microFET2** or **ergoFET**.  The MT stabilizer
kit transforms microFET2 handheld dynamometer or ergoFET gauge from a “semi-fixed” to more “fixed”
testing method by improving stabilization and minimizing tester influence.

[View Product Details][38]
* [[MicroFET2 Stabilizer Kit for Muscle testing]][39]
* [[Hands adjusting ankle strap over sneakers]][40]
* [[Ankle monitor strapped to seated person's legs]][41]

## Hoggan Scientific Extends Free Warranty Coverage from One Year to Three Years to Thank Customers

To show Hoggan Scientific’s ongoing commitment to customer satisfaction and product excellence, they
are announcing a major enhancement to its warranty policy. Effective immediately, all new devices
purchased after September 4, 2025 will be covered by a three-year warranty, up from the previous
one-year coverage period, at no cost to customers. This milestone reflects not only Hoggan
Scientifc’s dedication to standing behind these products but also their pride in maintaining
rigorous quality standards, as demonstrated by their ISO and MDR certifications.

## Hoggan Scientific’s continuous commitment to the highest quality standards have resulted in
## accomplishment of IS0 13485:2016 for the scope of the design, development, and manufacture of
## non-sterile dynamometer and inclinometer measuring devices and related accessories of our
## MicroFET product line.

[28th Madrid World Congress ISMST]

[professional shockwave therapy machine LGT-2500X (1)]
Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller

Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]

High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]

High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]

## ¿Por qué AW Dynamometer es la referencia mundial en dinamómetros?

AW Dynamometer fabrica equipos de prueba desde 1957 y ya superó las 14.000 unidades vendidas en todo
el mundo, lo que la convierte en la marca más utilizada en pruebas de TDF de tractores agrícolas,
motores diésel y motores eléctricos. Sus dinamómetros utilizan un freno por fricción (prony brake)
hidráulico, refrigerado por agua, capaz de soportar pruebas prolongadas y de asentamiento de motor
sin perder precisión — una ventaja decisiva frente a los dinamómetros por corriente de Foucault en
aplicaciones agrícolas e industriales de uso intensivo.

Por eso, marcas como John Deere, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Case IH, Kubota, Valtra y LS Tractor
utilizan dinamómetros AW tanto en sus líneas de producción como en sus redes de concesionarios en
toda América Latina. Los equipos AW también se destacan por su bajo costo de mantenimiento: muchos
modelos operan hasta diez años sin intervención significativa en la unidad de carga.

Como distribuidor exclusivo de AW Dynamometer para la región, Torqx ofrece soporte técnico en 18
países, capacitación oficial para operadores y repuestos originales para toda la línea AW, incluida
la histórica Serie Nebraska.

## ¿Por qué AW Dynamometer es la referencia mundial en dinamómetros?

AW Dynamometer fabrica equipos de prueba desde 1957 y ya superó las 14.000 unidades vendidas en todo
el mundo, lo que la convierte en la marca más utilizada en pruebas de TDF de tractores agrícolas,
motores diésel y motores eléctricos. Sus dinamómetros utilizan un freno por fricción (prony brake)
hidráulico, refrigerado por agua, capaz de soportar pruebas prolongadas y de asentamiento de motor
sin perder precisión — una ventaja decisiva frente a los dinamómetros por corriente de Foucault en
aplicaciones agrícolas e industriales de uso intensivo.

Por eso, marcas como John Deere, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Case IH, Kubota, Valtra y LS Tractor
utilizan dinamómetros AW tanto en sus líneas de producción como en sus redes de concesionarios en
toda América Latina. Los equipos AW también se destacan por su bajo costo de mantenimiento: muchos
modelos operan hasta diez años sin intervención significativa en la unidad de carga.

Como distribuidor exclusivo de AW Dynamometer para la región, Torqx ofrece soporte técnico en 18
países, capacitación oficial para operadores y repuestos originales para toda la línea AW, incluida
la histórica Serie Nebraska.
